collect._comment_collect: Phase 4.5 — Lighthouse CI. Hits the URLs through the same already-running frontend the Playwright suite uses; saves CI minutes by sharing the build.

settings._skip_audit_comment: uses-rel-preconnect: third-party (Google Fonts) noise unavoidable until we self-host; track separately.

assert._assert_comment: Today's measured baseline (Phase 4): landing ~0.71 Performance / ~1000 ms TBT — three.js initialisation on the BiomeScene dominates the main thread. Performance / TBT / FCP are tracked as warnings so the gate stays informational while we work the perf-budget thread (defer three.js until user interaction, downscale DPR, etc.). LCP / CLS / a11y stay hard gates — they're universal best practices we already meet.
